player_prompt.intro:
Welcome to Frozen Lake!

You are represented by 'P' on the grid.
Grid symbols:
  ' ' = Frozen surface (safe to walk on)
  'H' = Hole (fall in and lose!)
  'G' = Goal (reach this to win!)
  'P' = Your current position

Available actions: up, down, left, right (or w, a, s, d)
Type your action as: [up], [down], [left], [right] or [w], [a], [s], [d]

Objective: Navigate from the start (top-left) to the goal (bottom-right) without falling into any holes!

invalid_move.unknown_action: Kisalu ya me zabana ve '{action}'. Sadila zulu, na nsi, diboko ya kimama, dibolo ya kibakala to w, a, s, d.

outcome.win: Yo kele mbote, nge me nunga!
outcome.fell_in_hole: Nge me bwa na dibulu! Nsaka ya nsuka. Nge manisaka {pct}% ya nzietelo sambu na kukuma na kisika yina nge zolaka kukwenda.
outcome.turn_limit: Nge me kuma na nsuka ya kitamina yina nge fwete tambula sambu na kukuma kisika yina kele ntama ti mbanza! Nsaka me mana. Nge me sala {pct}% ya nzietelo tii kuna ya nge ta manisa yo.
